guiding_question: વહાણ, સઢ અને સુકાનનું ચિત્ર બતાવીને કવિ 'આપણે જ આપણે છઈએ' એ વાત સુધી કઈ રીતે લઈ જાય છે ?

objectives.objective_text: શરૂઆતની ગવાતી પંક્તિઓમાં કવિ કયા હાથને ઝાલવાનું કહે છે તે શોધીને, એ જ પંક્તિ ફરી ફરી ગવાય ત્યારે અવાજમાં શું થાય તે કહેવું.
પહેલી કડીમાં એકતારો લઈને ગાનારનું ચિત્ર કઈ પંક્તિમાં આવે છે તે શોધીને, કવિ એ ભરોસાને ખોટો કેમ કહે છે તે પોતાના શબ્દોમાં કહેવું.
બીજી કડીમાં કવિ બાહુમાં અને હૈયામાં શું ભરવાનું કહે છે તે શોધીને, વહાણનાં સઢ-સુકાન કોના હાથે રહે તે કહેવું, ને પોતે જાતે કરેલું એક કામ કહેવું.
ત્રીજી કડી ડુબાડનાર, ઉગારનાર અને સામે પાર લઈ જનાર વિશે જે પ્રશ્નો પૂછે છે તે ગણાવીને, છેલ્લી પંક્તિ એનો શો જવાબ આપે છે તે કહેવું.

Agent 1 explicitly left this decision to Agent 2 ('The opening four lines are the ટેક block, NOT a કડી … Agent 2 decides whether the ટેક block forms its own unit'). Reason from the page: the block stands above and apart from the three કડી, it is not counted in structure_inventory.kadi (which is 3), and it carries a picture of its own that no કડી repeats — 'એક મહેનતના હાથને ઝાલીએ.' It is a reading scene, not a repetition to fold away. Consequence: topic count is 4 while structure_inventory.kadi is 3.

Refrain shorthand, for Agent 5: 01_meta.json records tek_occurrences=5 — the full line twice inside the opening ટેક block, and the printed shorthand '- હો ભેરુ.' closing each of the three કડી. Agent 1 kept the shorthand INSIDE each કડી's last line rather than emitting a separate marker for it, so the three shorthand returns are not topics and are not counted above. original_chunk must reproduce '- હો ભેરુ.' exactly as printed at the end of each કડી topic; expanding it to the full refrain line is a verbatim defect (urmikavya_geet.md avoid list).

No pre-reading opener topic, no CONCEPT topic and no REVIEW topic exist in this chapter. The blue પ્રવેશપેટી on printed p. 25 is teacher-addressed apparatus (spec §1, global_content_rules.md) and 01_meta.json's own marker line labels it 'શિક્ષકને સંબોધીને; સ્વાધ્યાય નથી'; the શબ્દાર્થ box is gloss furniture; વાતચીત is numbered exercise block one in exercise_inventory. Std 7 prints no unlabelled કવિ-પરિચય paragraph for the student (that is a std-10 shape), so the byline '- પ્રહ્લાદ પારેખ' is a byline only. No in-text wrap is printed, so nothing is REVIEW.

No page-versus-prior conflict. The profile prior for ઊર્મિકાવ્ય-ગીત is 'one કડી per topic' and the rendered page shows exactly three કડી around one unchanging refrain; urmikavya_geet.md and explanation_unit_map.md both name this very chapter's '- હો ભેરુ.' as the identical-refrain case. The page and the table agree.

Craft-label ceiling honoured: no અલંકાર, છંદ, સમાસ or સાહિત્યપ્રકાર label appears in any objective_text — no form word at all is used, not even 'ગીત' (which the printed પ્રવેશપેટી does carry, so it would have been permissible). The objectives ask the child to notice which hand, which picture, whose hands, and what the last line answers — never to name a device. Downstream, per profiles/students/std-7.md §2, figures_of_speech[] stays [] for every topic here; that is a complete answer, not a gap. The પ્રાસ this poem carries inside each કડી (હાલીએ / ઝાલીએ / પિછાણીએ, ઝુકાવીએ / સંભાળીએ, ઉગારે / પાર / છઈએ) is available to Agent 12 as a sound observation without a label.

difficulty is set by what stops an A2 second-language reader on THIS page, not by size of idea. M1.S1.T1 is 'easy': four short lines, two of them identical, and only હાલીએ and ભેરુ are તળપદાં. M1.S1.T2 is 'hard': it is the longest કડી (five printed lines), it carries the chapter's most abstract move (ખુદનો ભરોસો → ખુદાનો ભરોસો નકામ), an unfamiliar object-world word (એકતારો, not in the printed શબ્દાર્થ box), and the constructions 'છો ને' and 'પિછાણીએ'. M2.S2.T3 and M2.S2.T4 are 'medium': both carry glossed sailing and dialect words (મોઝારે, સુકાન, હામ, કરવૈયો, છઈએ) but their sentences are short and the printed શબ્દાર્થ box already lifts five of them. No topic is hard for craft, per the std 6–7 row of the spec's table.

Module cut follows the poem's own two movements, which 01_meta.json's genre_signals record: M1 holds the call and what it turns away from (the hand of મહેનત to hold; the એકતારો singer whose borrowed trust the poet calls ખોટું); M2 holds the single sustained sea picture that the rest of the poem is built out of (બળ, હામ, સાગર, વહાણ, સઢ, સુકાન — then ડુબાડે, ઉગારે, સામે પાર). M2.S2.T4 is tagged 'climax' because the picture resolves in the poem's last line, 'આપણે જ આપણે છઈએ', which is also what the chapter's own guiding_question aims at.

Segments group topics that belong together rather than one-per-topic: M1.S1 holds the sung call and the કડી that answers it from the opposite side; M2.S2 holds the two કડી of the one boat-picture, where કડી 3's ડુબાડે / ઉગારે / સામે પાર has no scene of its own without કડી 2's વહાણ. Segment counter runs across the chapter and does not restart (M1.S1, M2.S2); concept counter is chapter-continuous and equals the topic number throughout (C1…C4), per phase2_contract.md rule 4.

depends_on carries real dependence only. Three topics list M1.S1.T1 because the identical-ટેક gate requires it — each કડી ends in the shorthand that only M1.S1.T1 has taught. M2.S2.T4 additionally lists M2.S2.T3 because its three questions are asked about the boat and the sea that કડી 2 put on the water; read alone, 'કોણ લઈ જાય સામે પાર' has no vessel. Agent 14 must translate all of these references if it renumbers.

SENSITIVITY, carried forward from 01_meta.json for Agents 5, 7, 8 and 12: M1.S1.T2 (કડી 1) dismisses passive reliance using both a Muslim and a Hindu name — 'ખુદાનો ભરોસો નકામ' and the quoted 'તારે ભરોસે રામ !'. O2 is deliberately written on the એકતારો-singer PICTURE and on the poem's own word ખોટું, and names neither divine name, so the objective keeps the teaching on શ્રમ-મહિમા and આત્મબળ. Per global_content_rules.md rule ten this કડી must never become a lesson about faith, and the એકતારો and its singer are presented with dignity.

Uneven topic length, flagged not blocking: M1.S1.T1 holds four printed lines, M1.S1.T2 five, and M2.S2.T3 and M2.S2.T4 four each (01_meta.json lines_per_kadi = [5,4,4]). The genre profile allows a કડી-unit to join or split on content; no join or split was needed here, and no કડી was merged or divided.

Two-column read-down hazard does not apply: Agent 1 recorded the verse as single-column throughout, set in the left half of the full-page boat watercolour on printed p. 25. No render was opened by this agent — 00_chapter_normalized.md and 01_meta.json answered every structural question.
